mentions.name: goformersearch
mentions.description: A pure Go vector index offering brute-force and HNSW search behind the same interface, swappable with one line. Targets 10k-50k vector workloads, with HNSW queries under 0.5ms at 50k vectors and a documented crossover point (around 2,400 vectors at 384 dimensions) where HNSW beats brute-force.
mentions.problem: Pulling in FAISS for small index sizes (10k-50k vectors) brings C++/Python CGO dependencies that pure Go avoids.
mentions.source_excerpt: goformersearch (https://www.mikeayles.com/blog/goformersearch/) is the vector index. Brute-force and HNSW, same interface, swap with one line. I couldn't justify pulling in FAISS for the index sizes I'm dealing with (10k-50k vectors), and the pure Go HNSW searches in under 0.5ms at 50k vectors.
